name: kaichenpedia
author: c-wenlong
description: Personal wiki: a Next.js app built from the private kaichenpedia repo's site/Dockerfile and run as one container that serves the pages and /api/* (in-browser editing + copilot). deployd polls GitHub every minute and rebuilds the image on new commits; a failed build keeps the running container and an unhealthy one is rolled back, so pushing from any device is the publish step. ~/services/kaichenpedia/bin/deploy.sh --force rebuilds now. An amber tile means the container is down; a stale page with a green tile means a build is failing (see the deployd log).
